parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: The Operating Class per {{bibref|802.11ax|Table E-4}} that this radio is capable of operating on.

parameters.name: MaxTxPower
parameters.description: Maximum Transmit Power EIRP that this radio is capable of transmitting in the current regulatory domain for the Operating Class. Represented as 2's complement signed integer in units of decibels relative to 1 mW ({{units}}).

parameters.name: NonOperable
parameters.description: {{list}} The channel numbers which are statically non-operable in the Operating Class (i.e. the Radio is never able to operate on these channels). Other channels from this Operating Class which are not listed here are supported for the Radio.

parameters.name: NumberOfNonOperChan
parameters.description: The number of non-operable channels contained in {{param|NonOperable}}.

object.description: Describes one of the possible Operating Classes supported by this Radio.
